newsitem.title: USA: NEC unit plans $110 mln plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: NEC unit plans $110 mln plant expansion.

text.p: NEC Corp unit NEC Electronics Inc said Wednesday it will invest $110 million to expand its Roseville, Calif., semiconductor chip plant, making it available for wafer fabrication.
The investment will not require additional facilities or changes to the current workforce in Roseville.

"This expansion allows NEC to continue to offer customers a breadth of products that includes more advanced devices built using smaller and smaller design processes," said Russell Childs, associate vice president of operations.
